1. Category 2 (CAT-2) Dorm Rooms
These are student dorm rooms with the following features:
•	Private bathroom inside the room
•	In-room kitchen (small cooking area allowed)
•	Air-conditioning and balcony included
This is the most common student option that includes both a private bathroom and kitchen. (Google Sites)
2. Category 5 (CAT-5) Dorm/Mixed Units
These rooms are typically larger and also include:
•	Private bathroom
•	Kitchen with refrigerator and hot plate
•	Air-conditioning and balcony
CAT-5 units are often allocated for students needing larger spaces (such as married students), though continuing students may queue for them. (Google Sites)
3. Student Village – Married Units
In the on-campus Student Village (Married) category:
•	Private bathroom
•	Full kitchen (refrigerator and gas stove)
•	Separate bedroom and living space
These units are designed for married students or families. (Google Sites)

Summary of On-Campus Room Types with Private Bath + Kitchen
Accommodation Type	Private Bathroom	Kitchen (Cooking Allowed)	Typical Use
CAT-2	Yes	Yes	Single students
CAT-5	Yes	Yes	Larger/luxury rooms, often married
Student Village – Married	Yes	Yes	Married/student families

Notes
•	CAT-2 is usually the standard “ensuite” student option with kitchen and bathroom in the room. (Google Sites)
•	CAT-5 and Student Village married units are larger and often more expensive. (Google Sites)
•	Kitchen facilities are usually basic (fridge, cooking plate), not full apartment-style kitchens. (Facilities Management)
